summary.short: Amends the Besluit kwaliteit leefomgeving from 1 January 2024 to define hyperscale data centres (over 10 ha built area and 70 MW or more connection capacity) and bars municipal environmental plans from permitting new ones across the Netherlands, except two named areas in Het Hogeland and Hollands Kroon.
summary.long: Adds paragraph 5.1.7.7 on hyperscale data centres to the Besluit kwaliteit leefomgeving under the Omgevingswet. Article 5.161ba defines a hyperscale data centre as operating a data or computing centre with more than 10 ha built floor area and an electrical connection capacity of 70 MW or more, including functionally supporting activities on the same site. Article 5.161bb makes the whole territory of the Netherlands the exclusion area, except certain locations in Het Hogeland and Hollands Kroon whose boundaries are set by ministerial regulation. Article 5.161bc provides that an environmental plan applying to the exclusion area does not permit hyperscale data centres. Article 12.26d requires the competent authority to implement this by the time set in article 22.5(1) of the Omgevingswet. The rule is an instructieregel under article 2.24(1) of the Omgevingswet, takes effect on 1 January 2024, and does not apply to activities permitted under an environmental permit for building work. The explanatory note states that existing and already permitted hyperscale data centres are not affected and that municipalities have until 1 January 2032 to amend their plans.

notes: Empty strings are used for target_instrument_id, lei and ticker where the schema requires a string but no registry ID or verified identifier is available. Internal inconsistency: art. 5.161bb sets the area boundary by ministeriële regeling, while the Nota (par. 2.2 and the artikelsgewijze toelichting on onderdeel B) refers to the Omgevingsregeling, bijlage III, art. 2.21. Art. 5.161ba lid 2 defines the facility by reference to art. 3.235 Bal; the Nota paraphrases the definition as support for dataverkeer or dataopslag. Per Nota par. 7, the instructieregel does not bind citizens and firms until the omgevingsplan is amended; the text announces a separate voorbereidingsbesluit by the Minister of BZK at the entry into force of the Omgevingswet, which is not part of this text.

obligations.summary: Within the exclusion area for hyperscale data centres, the omgevingsplan (the municipal environmental plan, under the competent authority) shall not permit any hyperscale data centre. The duty applies only insofar as an omgevingsplan applies to that area.
obligations.applies_from: met ingang van 1 januari 2024 (Artikel II, entry into force of the decision)

The explanatory note gives 1 January 2032 for that time; the operative text does not state the date.

enforcement.note: The operative articles (Art. I A–D, Art. II) contain no fine, penalty, licence revocation or other sanction. The nota van toelichting, section 5 'Uitvoering, toezicht en handhaving', describes supervisory measures against municipalities (taakverwaarlozing via the province, interbestuurlijk toezicht including suspension or annulment of a municipal decision), but these are not operative provisions of this text and no penalty amounts are stated, so no sanction regime is coded.
